iframe.title: Circuit simulator — AND gate
note_html:
You are looking at an AND gate: the output is high only when both inputs are high. Click the two inputs on the left to toggle them, and watch the output on the right.
Circuit data is embedded in the URL (cct=) — not loaded from Falstad’s removed /circuits/and.txt. Simulator UI still needs falstad.com. Local copy of the circuit: and.txt beside this page.
